results.final_feedback: No supplied candidate semantically supports the required Class Factors table-lookup constraint, selector, comparison model, or result path.

Do not let the simple-support branch pass merely because continuity, ice-area termination, or rotational-restraint demonstration data are absent. Use the supplied nltl:demonstratedRotationalRestraint on the relevant nltl:memberSupport: the rotational-restraint fixed-support alternative must require demonstratedRotationalRestraint true together with significantRotationalRestraintEvidence, while the simple-support alternative must require explicit false values for connectionBracketPresent and demonstratedRotationalRestraint and explicit false values for continuousThroughSupport and terminatesWithinIceStrengthenedArea. Replace the absence-based sh:not logic accordingly; the required canonical term is already supplied, so no matcher is needed.
No supplied candidate semantically represents the attached-plate-flange area required for the applicability comparison.
No supplied canonical candidate verifies a member-owned strength property or a canonical cross-owner path from each structural member/load case to the ship-owned plasticStrength fact.
Faithfully encodes the ship-to-case/table-lookup structure, required inputs, controlled values, units, selection evidence, Table 8 reference, and actual-grade-not-less-than-required-grade comparison.

Candidate faithfully targets ships through the canonical calculation-case path, constrains the declared owners and units, enforces selected endpoint membership and interval ordering, and verifies the linear interpolation result using a tolerance scaled from the expected result.

Candidate faithfully encodes the ship-level conditional classification using the supplied controlled origin and ice-type terms, inclusive growth/thickness bounds, metre quantity validation, and exact first-year-ice conclusion.

Candidate faithfully targets ship-owned inputs, enforces the required quantity datatypes and units, applies the inclusive 10-year threshold with the correct conditional approval branch, and validates MDLT as the average of daily low temperatures using expected-result-scaled tolerance.

Remove the sh:or branch that permits nltl:polarCodeApplies to be absent. Conditional alternatives must not pass when branch-selection evidence is missing; require exactly one xsd:boolean applicability value and retain the false and true branches, with certificate-present and certificate-status true required only in the true branch.
No supplied candidate is a canonical controlled date-type value or a canonical relationship/path identifying applicable SOLAS schedule records.

Candidate faithfully targets ships and enforces the required PWOM and stability-calculation record evidence, required true presence statement, required value availability, and bidirectional equality of the supplied icing-allowance value properties.

Candidate faithfully enforces the required ship-to-pump-to-containing-compartment path, covers all specified pump types, requires a compartment with maintained temperature, enforces DEG_C, and rejects non-numeric or non-positive temperature values without imposing unsupported existence requirements.

Candidate faithfully encodes the required ship-level conditional alternative, including the daylight exception, count and coverage conjunction, approved alternative evidence status, decimal angle quantity with DEG unit, and inclusive thresholds.

Candidate faithfully encodes the conditional universal minimum-device requirement using the supplied ship-to-survival-craft path, required applicability and release selectors, correct owner placements, canonical terms, ranges, datatypes, and non-vacuous branch logic.

Candidate faithfully encodes the complete 12.3.1 controlled matrix, owner paths, applicable credential evidence, valid-STCW condition, not-applicable alternatives, controlled selectors, and required cardinalities without unsupported vocabulary or accidental applicability logic.
Candidate faithfully encodes the controlled discharge-material exception on the required ship owner: clean or segregated ballast classification requires the paragraph 1.1.1 applicability value false.
No supplied candidate is a verified controlled xsd:string passenger ship-type value; passengerShip is a Class and shipType is the selector property.

Candidate faithfully encodes the ship-level conditional requirement: polar-operation coverage is required in all three specified garbage documents/placards only when shipOperatesInPolarWaters is true.

Candidate faithfully targets ships, requires the date selector and date datatype, applies the two specified 2021 provisions to all ships, and conditionally requires the 2021 regulation edition from 5 July 2021 onward.

Repair the SHACL-SPARQL syntax errors by placing each BIND before FILTER clauses that follow it (notably the square-root-domain and section-modulus queries), so the embedded queries parse in the deterministic evaluator. Complete the required table-lookup model path by adding to TRF060TableLookupCaseShape a mandatory nltl:lookupSelectionEvidence property (minCount 1, appropriate evidenceArtifact node/class constraint); the lookup-selection evidence relationship is required by the COMPLETE dependency contract and must remain on the tableLookupCase.

Make fixedPitchPropellerReversalLoadIncluded true conditional on pitchType = "fixed"^^xsd:string. The current conjunction wrongly requires fixed-pitch reversal-load evidence for controllable-pitch propellers. Retain the normal-service-life, normal-operational-conditions, stopped-propeller-dragging-outside-model, and radial-ice-entry-outside-model evidence for both applicable pitch types.

Candidate faithfully targets ship and requires the canonical blade-loss design evidence plus a load case confirming the maximum-component-load blade orientation.

Candidate is structurally valid and faithfully encodes the supplied TRF-114 owners, paths, table references, quantity datatypes and units, capacity comparison direction, and non-hemispherical conditional radius/evidence requirement.

Remove the unsupported sh:minCount/sh:maxCount evidence-cardinality constraints and xsd:decimal restrictions on the input properties: the verified requirement requires the conditional charging-time/rate comparison when the supplied inputs are present, but does not independently require one recorded value for each input or declare decimal as the canonical numeric datatype. Retain the canonical unit checks and the bounded conditional comparison; no vocabulary lookup is needed.
